How this customer science company increased its hiring quotient by 10X
Assessments
HackerEarth’s platform has helped us create customized assessments on open source technologies. This has made hiring the right talent easy. Conversion rates from assessments to actual hiring has increased by 10 fold!
Manoj Parikatil Director of Talent Acquisition
APAX, Dunnhumby
About Dunnhumby
Dunnhumby powers algorithms like the ones behind Tesco’s loyalty card. The key to a company’s success is its talent, and the U.K.-based customer science company wanted to hire the best data scientists. But like any other company, Dunnhumby faced an uphill task finding great people. Here is the strategy the company employed to increase the efficiency of its hiring process 10 fold.
What is Dunnhumby's story?
Dunnhumby is one of the global leading customer-science companies, which creates personalized customer experiences on digital, mobile, and retail platforms by analyzing data and applying insights derived from over one billion customers worldwide.
It was founded in 1989 with the mission of helping companies understand its customers’ needs. Dunnhumby worked with Tesco to develop the innovative Clubcard loyalty program thus helping one of the world’s largest retailers and brands to use the power of customer-data analytics from business decision-making to driving sales.
Requirements
Dunnhumby partnered with HackerEarth to conduct customized assessments to hire recent graduates with the best knowledge of open source technology.
Challenges
To scale and assess a large pool of candidates while utilizing minimal time and resources
To create customized skill-based assessments
24/7 customer support
HackerEarth Recruit as a solution
Increase number of hires
Dunnhumby was able to see a drastic increase in the number of quality candidates that were screened and hired during campus hiring drives.
Customized skill-based tests
Dunnhumby created various types of questions and saved these in the custom library. Since there is no restriction on the number of questions that can be created and saved, the company can build its library and reuse questions when required.
Simple and easy-to-use interface
HackerEarth Recruit has a simple interface that is easy to navigate.
HackerEarth’s support team was available round the clock for any queries, feedback, and requirements.
What was the outcome?
Dunnhumby successfully conducted hiring drives for various positions, functions, and locations through campus hiring.
The team was very pleased with the support it received during the hiring process with respect to queries or concerns about the usage of the product and the increase in the conversion rates.
